QF.id: Registration, Code of Conduct and General Obligations_47

question.text: Under Regulation 26, a merchant banker is prohibited from transacting in securities of a body corporate based on UPSI obtained during which type of activity?

explanation.text: The Logic: Regulation 26 provides that a merchant banker and the listed covered persons shall not transact in the securities of a body corporate on the basis of unpublished price sensitive information obtained during the course of any professional assignment, whether from clients or otherwise. The prohibition is anchored to the professional-assignment nexus. The Trap: The other options describe general activities that are not the source phrase of Regulation 26; the regulation targets UPSI obtained during professional assignments specifically. Note: The prohibition applies to transactions based on UPSI obtained in the course of professional assignments, rather than to any deal-related information automatically.
